name: labelled initial transition and reconverging exits
body:
[*] --> Queued : enqueue creates the job
Queued --> Started : dequeued after preparing
Queued --> Skipped : dequeued before preparing
Started --> Finishing : previous job settled
Finishing --> Released : completion callback after cleanup
Started --> Released : worker leaves the pool
Finishing --> Released : worker leaves the pool
Skipped --> Released : cleanup releases it
Released --> [*]

name: multiple labelled boundaries and state names resembling boundaries
body:
[*] --> Initial : begin
[*] --> Initial : resume
[*] --> Final
Initial --> Final : finish
Final --> [*] : release
Initial --> [*] : cancel

name: labelled initial transition without a final boundary
